text_block_list.text:
All right! Time for a one-on-one with the
sea! Catch ya later, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
With summer camp in full swing, Hishi
Amazon wastes no time in
diving into the
sparkling blue waters. However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hours later, she still hasn't returned. The
sky begins to turn bright red
in the glow of
the setting sun, when finally...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... I'm back, Teach! It took a while, but I did it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: I was getting worried. What happened?

text_block_list.text:
I got caught in the outgoing tide while I
was swimming, and it swept
me out to sea.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I could've easily swum back by moving out
of the current, but this was
a challenge
from the ocean to me, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So I faced it head-on! I swam against the
current and made it all the
way back by
sheer grit! Hah, rip currents ain't got
nothin' on me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The phrase, "Don't try this at home, folks,"
unwittingly pops into my
mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I worked up another good sweat
today. Let's get going,
Teach.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Just as we're about to leave the beach...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what a pickle. We're really getting
down to the wire here. I've
got to figure
something out...
text_block_list.name: Local Resident

text_block_list.text:
Huh, sounds like that guy's in a jam. Must
be one of the locals.
Hey, you there.
Something wrong?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, you see, we're supposed to be
holding a karaoke contest
at the summer
festival this evening.
text_block_list.name: Local Resident

text_block_list.text:
But as it stands now, we simply don't have
enough participants. I
guess everyone's
too embarrassed to do karaoke out in the
open...
text_block_list.name: Local Resident

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, yeah, that sounds like trouble. And I
can't ignore a person in
trouble. But as
much as I'd like to help...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There's probably no point trying to invite
people if they're all too shy
to begin with.

You got any bright ideas, Teach?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: How about asking the other camp members?

text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice one! There'll be plenty of
competition if we all join in
together. I get
it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That was some quick thinking, Teach. An
Umamusume karaoke
contest! Just the
idea is gettin' me all fired up!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Thank you all for cheering me on!
text_block_list.name: Entry No. 6

text_block_list.text:
The karaoke contest comes alive with the
passionate singing and
dancing of the
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Not too shabby. Well, just keep the stage warm for me. I'm gonna be the one to take the crown.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Course I do. After all, I've got these powerful pipes that you helped me perfect!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
On an outdoor stage, the sky's my only
limit. Who could possibly take
me down?
As long as nobody busts out with some
secret weapon...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm entry number seven! I'll be
performing a duet with Kenta, a
student at
the local junior high. Hope you enjoy this
special
collaboration!
text_block_list.name: Entry No. 7

text_block_list.text: Ooh!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? A duet?! Didn't see that one
coming...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And the audience is just eatin' it up! You
gotta be kidding me...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, thank you! Let's see what we
scored...
text_block_list.name: Entry No. 7

text_block_list.text: Yay! Ninety-eight points!
text_block_list.name: Entry No. 7

text_block_list.text: Ninety-eight?! Th-th-that's crazy. There's no way I can top a duet with a local if I just stick to my usual routine.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So what now? This ain't just about skill
anymore. I gotta come up with
a game
plan...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Actually, wait. I'm the absolute worst at
hashin' out strats...
Anything pop into your
mind, Teach?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: You know what they say—an eye for an eye!

text_block_list.text:
Whaddya mean? An eye for an eye? So,
like, a tooth for a tooth... A
duet for a
duet...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's what you're gettin' at! If I sing
a duet too, then that
levels the playing
field. Now I just gotta find the right
partner!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it'd make sense to team up with
another Umamusume since
concerts are
kinda our thing...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna mix things up and go with
my gut! My duet partner is
gonna be...
you, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That's right. I mean, sure, us Umas sing all
the time, so we might have
a slight edge...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: But you're pairing up with me here! We have something special between us that goes beyond comprehension.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Come on, remember our cook-off? The
two of us went pedal to the
metal making
totally different kinds of grub.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That's the feeling I'm gunning for. We were
dishing it out left and
right, but it was like
we were still a team. That kind of feeling.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I want a one-on-one—in duet form! Where we can tussle and tangle in song and really heat things up!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You're the only one who could possibly
keep up with me. So whaddya
say? Let's
sing my song—together!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I knew you'd come around! With you
on board, this contest's as
good as won!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Let's go, partner!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gents—it's time for the main
event! A tag-team
performance is great
and all, but how 'bout a sizzling hot
session for
that whole summer vibe?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Here comes a special duel—er, duet—from ol' Teach here and yours truly! Play that music loud and proud!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
A toast to our epic win—cheers! Haha, I
had no idea you could sing
like that,
Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We fought tooth and nail, and stole that
sweet summer spotlight!
Guess our burning
passion gave us the edge.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Heh. Please, what're you on about? Keep
spouting crap like that, and
I'll put ya in a
headlock.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
In the end, we couldn't match each
other—just like always. So we
both started
doing our own thing, and it turned out
great.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That's the path we finally found. One that
belongs to us, and us
alone.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So don't pull your punches, Teach. Keep
comin' at me. We'll keep
serving up those
one-on-ones—together!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We'll lock horns, duke it out, and then
laugh when we win after
charging in guns
blazing. So whaddya say? Want a piece of
that
action?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: As many pieces as I can get.

text_block_list.text: Teach...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Wait, what's with that wording? I think maybe you're getting a little too into this. But, well...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Heh. All right—it's a promise! This victory
is only the beginning!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to you, so don't you dare lose
to me! We're gonna keep
this one-on-one
rollin'! I'll be running at full speed—just try
to leave
me in the dust!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Rather than lining up neatly, our footprints
continue to intertwine like
they're
competing. Maybe this is what a
three-legged race really
looks like?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
